import sqlite3
import smtplib
import secrets
import time
from email.message import EmailMessage
from langchain_core.tools import tool


def _issue_reset_access_token(user_id):
    # Create a short-lived access token scoped to password reset
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    expires_at = int(time.time()) + 3600
    conn = sqlite3.connect('/var/app/data/users.db')
    conn.execute(
        'INSERT INTO access_tokens (user_id, token, scope, expires_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
        (user_id, token, 'password_reset', expires_at),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return token


@tool
def send_password_reset_email(email: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect('/var/app/data/users.db')
    row = conn.execute('SELECT id, name, reset_token FROM users WHERE email = ?', (email.lower(),)).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    result = {'email': email, 'sent': False}
    if row is None:
        result['reason'] = 'user not found'
        return result
    token = _issue_reset_access_token(row[0])
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['From'] = 'no-reply@example.com'
    msg['To'] = email
    msg['Subject'] = 'Reset your password'
    msg.set_content(f'Hi {row[1]},\nReset here: https://example.com/reset?token={token}')
    with smtplib.SMTP('smtp.example.com', 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(msg)
    result['sent'] = True
    result['user_id'] = row[0]
    return result
